content.title: Fan-favorite Samsung Messages app is getting discontinued soon
content.text: Abhijeet Mishra / SamMobile APK Samsung's in-house apps on Galaxy devices - Source: Abhijeet Mishra / SamMobile A few years ago, Samsung switched from Samsung Messages to Google Messages as the default messaging app on Galaxy phones, tablets, and wearables. Now, the company has confirmed that it is discontinuing the Samsung Messages app entirely. Samsung Messages will be discontinued in favor of Google Messages Samsung has posted an ‘End of Service Announcement' notice on its website, revealing that the Samsung Messages app will be discontinued in July 2026. The company is also urging Galaxy users to switch to Google Messages for a more consistent messaging experience. Over the past few years, Samsung and Google have worked closely to expand RCS availability on Android devices. As part of this collaboration, Samsung began making Google Messages the default messaging app on newer Galaxy devices. Newer phones like Samsung Samsung Messages discontinuation announcement on Samsung's website – Source: Samsung How to switch from Samsung Messages to Google Messages To switch to Google Messages on your Galaxy device, follow these steps: Click here to find the app on the Google Play Store. Install the Google Messages app and open it once the installation is complete. When you open the app for the first time, you will see a prompt that says, “To use Messages, make it your default SMS app.” Tap Set default SMS app. On the next screen, select Google Messages (it has a white icon with a blue conversation bubble). Tap Set as default to confirm. Abhijeet Mishra / SamMobile Galaxy Z Fold 6 review: Google Messages – Source: Abhijeet Mishra / SamMobile Note 1: If your device is running Android 12 or Android 13, the Google Messages app may not automatically appear in the home screen dock. You may need to manually drag it from the app drawer to the dock. On some devices there may be a temporary discontinuation in RCS service during the switch. Note 2: Messages won't sync to your Galaxy Watch if it is running the Tizen operating system. Those include all Galaxy Watches launched before the Galaxy Watch 4. What upgrades and new features does Google Messages offers? Samsung Reasons to upgrade from Samsung Messages to Google Messages – Source: Samsung Better security: AI-powered spam and scam detection helps keep your messages and data safe by blocking suspicious texts. RCS messaging: You can send high-quality images and videos using RCS, which works across Android and iOS. Availability depends on your region and carrier. It also supports group chats, typing indicators, read receipts, emojis, stickers, and link previews. Automatic OTP deletion: It offers a feature that can delete messages containing one-time passwords (OTPs) automatically after 24 hours. Gemini-powered features: Google Messages includes AI features such as smart replies and image remixing. Multi-device connectivity: You can send and receive messages from a web browser or computer, with conversations synced across your phone, tablet, and smartwatch using your Google account. Asif Iqbal Shaik - Senior Editor [email protected] First Samsung device: T100 Asif is a computer engineer turned technology journalist. He has been using Samsung phones since 2004, and his current smartphone is the Galaxy S23 Ultra. He loves headphones, mechanical keyboards, and PC hardware. When not writing about technology, he likes watching crime and science fiction movies and TV shows.
